STEP 1 - Scene: A small plated meal of strawberries, spinach leaves and broccoli florets, photographed from above at a slight angle on a glass/wooden surface.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White square plate, roughly 25 cm across its longest edge. Taking a ~24 cm square-ish plate, area ≈ 24 x 24 x 0.85 ≈ 490 cm² (about 470 cm² after rounding corners). Use ~480 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: (a) fresh strawberries, sliced, about 4 halves/slices; (b) fresh spinach leaves; (c) cooked broccoli florets; (d) a few shreds of carrot.

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate, food covers ~45% total):
- Strawberries: ~12% (≈58 cm²)
- Spinach leaves: ~17% (≈82 cm²)
- Broccoli: ~13% (≈62 cm²)
- Carrot shreds: ~1% (≈5 cm²)

STEP 5 - Volume (outer envelope):
- Strawberries: 58 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 87 ml
- Spinach: 82 cm² x 2 cm ≈ 164 ml
- Broccoli: 62 cm² x 2.5 cm ≈ 155 ml
- Carrot: 5 cm² x 0.5 cm ≈ 3 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Strawberries: 87 x 0.6 ≈ 52 g
- Spinach: 164 x 0.15 ≈ 25 g
- Broccoli: 155 x 0.5 ≈ 78 g (cooked florets, somewhat dense)
- Carrot: 3 x 0.6 ≈ 2 g

STEP 7 - Energy (kcal/100 g):
- Strawberries: 52 g x 32 ≈ 17 kcal
- Spinach: 25 g x 23 ≈ 6 kcal
- Broccoli: 78 g x 35 ≈ 27 kcal
- Carrot: 2 g x 41 ≈ 1 kcal
Total ≈ 151 g, ≈ 51 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A partly covered ~24 cm plate with a modest portion of fruit and greens at roughly 150 g and ~50 kcal is plausible. Low-calorie vegetables dominate, so the energy total stays low.
